title: Multi-agent marketing with Joule and Gemini Enterprise (secondary report)
problem: Run campaign creation and optimisation across SAP and Google agents.
facts: The report says A2A links Google-built agents to Joule and MCP gives access to SAP data.
A retailer automation rate of 23% is quoted but not confirmed.
interpretations: Do not quote the 23% without a primary source.
review_exercise: Which consent and brand-safety controls are missing from this description?
lessons: Cross-vendor agent protocols raise governance questions first.
